text: Hello, I'm sorry to be a nuisance at this hour. My grandson is 10 and I think he's running a temperature, it says 39 on the thermometer. He also hasn't been to the toilet for a poo in three days and he's quite cross about it, keeps grumbling his tummy feels full. I'm not sure how much paracetamol or ibuprofen I'm allowed to give a boy his age, the boxes confuse me and I don't want to get it wrong. Could I give one or both? Sorry again, I just want to do it right.
